# obot_current_auth_provider (Data Source)

Reads the sole configured, non-staged authentication provider, exposing public metadata only. Errors when none or multiple match: Obot does not expose an authoritative active-provider flag. Requires an administrator token so staged replacements are visible. This is installation configuration, not the login provenance of the current API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "obot_current_auth_provider" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `group_id_prefix` (String) The identity-provider group ID prefix; empty when the provider does not declare one. Older Obot versions may not expose this field.
- `id` (String) The Obot authentication provider identifier.
- `name` (String) The authentication provider's display name.
- `namespace` (String) The Obot namespace containing this authentication provider.
